Companion Animal Travel Desk - Travel Intake and Fee Handling

The purpose of this section is to standardize how Aurelia Skyways processes companion animal travel requests through the Companion Animal Travel Desk, ensuring dependable, consistent handling from check-in to boarding.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk operates as the single intake point for travelers who require companion transport services between skyports. Upon arrival of a request, the desk team must verify traveler identity, confirm travel routing with the welcome team, and ensure the service change is recorded in the desk ledger before any animal handling begins. Staff must treat companion travel as operationally sensitive: approvals must be complete, documents must be aligned, and any service limitations must be communicated early enough to protect boarding flow. When a traveler arrives with a pet such as Ruby, the desk team must open a single handling file for that journey and keep it with the traveler’s packet throughout the preparation window.

Fee handling is mandatory and must be applied consistently for each entity category. For reptile transport, the governing fee sentence is provided by the template token <<FACT F060>>. Do not create alternative wording or parallel fee descriptions; use the inserted sentence exactly once in the desk record trail so that accounting, reconciliation, and audit queries remain traceable.

The desk ledger is the authoritative operational log. The desk team must document the requested service, any special handling notes, and all approvals required for the journey leg. If a service change occurs after the file is opened, the desk coordinator must update the ledger immediately and coordinate with the welcome team so boarding staff receive the corrected instructions in time. During preparation, ensure that handling steps do not delay boarding confirmations; apply service readiness checks in the same order every shift to reduce variability.

Compliance with container and handling requirements must be verified prior to dispatch of boarding cues. Staff must confirm that any companion animal is in an approved state for transport, including secure containment and any required preparation steps tied to the entity category. The desk team must also confirm that the traveler’s packet reflects the recorded service changes.

If complications arise during intake, file maintenance, or ledger updates, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk for immediate correction and escalation.
